Name: THE StonerVille Mod 2.0.1
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[size=6][u][b]🌿✨ StonerVille 2.0.1 ✨🌿[/b][/u][/size]
A cozy, magical marijuana-themed expansion for Stardew Valley 1.6 💚

[u]✅ OFFICIAL RELEASE: VERSION 2.0.1 ✅[/u]
🛠️ From here on: minor fixes and bug fixes only! 🛠️
────────────────────

[u][size=4]🆕 NEW IN 2.0.1 🆕[/size][/u]
- 📱 All 35 phone themes redrawn with new wallpapers and icon plates, plus a brand new Settings app: pick a theme, or choose the wallpaper and the icon style on their own, and flip dark mode, text size, banners and more. The home screen no longer has theme swatches, so a stray tap can never change your look.
- ⛲ Market Street fountain is now animated, with a stoner statue wearing a pot leaf beanie, and the street lamps glow after dusk. The Strain Tasting Tent is walk-in.
- 🏖️ The Beach got a big facelift: a bigger smoke circle with a rug, stone fire ring, lantern posts and string lights; a Beach Bar that looks like a real thatched building; a chill spot with a tide pool; and a redesigned Hidden Cove with glowing crystal cliffs, mossy walls and a mushroom grotto. The cove water is solid and you can fish in it.
- 💬 Smoke seshes and dates now happen on Market Street by the fountain. You arrive first and the villager walks in after. Invites run until 8pm and everyone heads home at 10pm.
- 🔥 One beach fire only. Teens drop by the fire only on some Friday and Saturday evenings, and never take part in anything smoking-related.
- 🍪 Edibles Oven, Golden Oven and Infusion Pot accept cured bud as well as dried bud.
- 🪟 Curtains fit normal windows: the five Clutter Curtains and the Crystal Bead Curtain are now one tile wide and two tall, so they place in a single window square and cover a normal window properly. Placed ones from older saves may need re-placing.
- 📱 Bigger corner phone: the little phone in the lower left corner of the screen is about 45% larger and easier to read.

[u][size=4]🆕 NEW IN 2.0 🆕[/size][/u]
- 🎁 Blunt Packs & Pre-roll Packs at the Rolling Table and Packing Table.
- 🍵 Calm Tea is a kitchen recipe, and recipes with milk or eggs take ANY milk or egg.
- 📱 Puffr statuses: post a status and watch villagers like and comment. Your profile picture shows on every post.
- 🪑 Furniture previews stay fully visible while you place them, and the Mushroom Floor Lamp no longer shrinks.
- 🧶 12 hemp products, 4 mini bongs, 12 craftable garden decor pieces, the Beverage Counter (8 colours), Request Boards (7 colours), the Dispensary Sign and 4 tie-dye tees.
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🌈 WHAT IS IT?[/size][/u][/b]
Grow over 30 custom strains 🌱 (including hybrids you breed yourself 🧬), process them in dozens of hand-drawn machines ⚙️, roll joints 🚬, press rosin 🍯, grind, press hash 🧱, sell to your neighbors 💰, take orders by letter 💌, share a hookah with the villagers 🪷, hang out on Market Street and the Beach 🏖️, run your life from a phone 📱, throw the Higher Vibez Festival 🎉 and build your own Stoner's Shed 🏠 with gypsy hippy furniture 🛏️. All wrapped in a COMPLETE green-to-lilac tie-dye UI 🌈 with an animated main menu 
💰 Always affordable: seeds 20-45g (Chocolate Mint 120g), machines 150-350g at Pierre's.
🎮 Mouse, keyboard AND controller all work.
🌍 Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Lilybrook & other villager mods.
🚫 Kids & teens are never involved in anything smoking-related.
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]📋 REQUIREMENTS[/size][/u][/b]
- 🧩 SMAPI 4.x
- 📦 Content Patcher
- 🎮 Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
- ✨ Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu
📁 ONE download, TWO folders: StonerVille (content pack) and StonerVilleGlasses (C# add-on). Drop BOTH into Mods!
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]📱 THE PHONE[/size][/u][/b]
Pierre sells a Phone for 600g. Open it with a hotkey (default P, controller: left stick click) or hold it and click. You only buy it once, it never has to stay in your bag. D-pad, A, B (back one page) and LB/RB tabs all work on a controller.

- 💼 Dealer: buy Dealer upgrades. Requests: see and deliver every open order.
- 📖 Strain Dex (every strain with its lean and terpene) and Machines (what is ready, where).
- 💬 Texts (docked at the lower left like a real phone): chat with villagers, invite them to a smoke sesh, group chat.
- 🌿 Puffr: friends, vibes, matches and sesh invites. Smoulder: adult romance (flirt, gifts, dates, be exclusive). Buzz: a feed where adult villagers post about their own lives, reply to each other and to you, and send you messages.
- 🏦 Bank: savings with interest, locked deposits, loans tied to Dealer Rep and a savings goal. Bills: what is due, pay all, auto-pay and history. Planner: a calendar that fills itself in, your own plans and checklists.
- 🛒 Bazaar Daze: a hippie market to buy, haggle, sell overnight and swap. Midnight Munch: nightly cravings, a Munchies meter and snack stacks. Astral: the moon, your sign, a tarot spread, crystals and intentions. Music: shuffles every jukebox song you have heard.
- ⚙️ Settings: Theme (35 themes in witchy, hippy, stoner, cottagecore, whimsy, magical, cozy, coastal, seasonal, retro and nature looks), Wallpaper and Icon style on their own, dark mode, text size, pop-up banners, the corner phone and Buzz alerts. More options live in Generic Mod Config Menu.
- 🍃 A sparkly weed-leaf mouse cursor in your phone theme colours (can be turned off), a custom chime for notifications, and a small corner phone with floating hearts when something new arrives.
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🏖️ MARKET STREET & THE BEACH[/size][/u][/b]
- 🛍️ Market Street: a lively street with stalls, the Munch Truck, a walk-in Strain Tasting Tent, a fountain with a stoner statue and glowing lamps. Up to nine villagers wander it. Smoke seshes and dates happen here: you arrive first, the villager walks in after.
- 🔥 The smoke circle: a rug, a ring of stones around a roaring fire, log seats, tiki torches, lantern posts and string lights. Roast marshmallows over any beach or cove fire.
- 🍹 The Beach Bar: a thatched hut with a counter, stools, surfboards and crates. Use the counter to shop.
- 🌴 The chill spot: palms, a hammock, a tide pool, towels and an umbrella.
- 💎 The Hidden Cove: walk through the crystal arch on the beach. Glowing crystal cliffs, moss and vines, a pastel rug round a fire, palms and a tide pool. You can fish in the cove, and forage Sea Lavender, Spiral Shells and Pink Starfish on the beach and in the cove.
- 🌙 The beach fires glow at night. Some Friday and Saturday evenings a few teens hang out at the smoke circle fire: bring marshmallows, no smoking involved.
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🌱 THE GROW LOOP[/size][/u][/b]
🌱 Plant → 🌿 Harvest → ☀️ Dry on a Rack → 🫙 Cure in a Jar → 💨 Smoke it, 💰 sell it, 🍪 bake it, or ✨ craft something better!
- 🍃 8 core strains: Northern Lights, Girl Scout Cookies, Pineapple Express, Blue Dream, Lemon Haze, Strawberry Cough, Sunset Sherbet, Chocolate Mint
- ❄️ Winter strains: Frostbite Kush, Snowcap Haze, Peppermint Frost, Golden Eggnog (they only grow in Winter), plus Hot Cocoa Kush
- 🍇 More strains: Granddaddy Purple, Mango Kush, Cherry Pie, Honey Chamomile and Sour Apple
- 🧬 Hybrids you breed yourself (see Crossbreeding below)
- 🍫 Chocolate Mint is the rare one. Its seeds unlock at Dealer Rep 3!
- 🌸 Fresh, Dried & Cured buds for every strain. Cured buds are gold quality!
- 📦 Batch processing: Racks, Jars, the Rosin Press & the Grinder take your whole stack; the Rolling Table lets you choose the batch
- 🏕️ Garden Tent (Robin's, 300g): two grow slots, grows in about 60% of the time. 🌿 Raised Bed with three planting slots.
- 🎛️ Config: seed prices, growing seasons, drying, curing & cooking times
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🧬 CROSSBREEDING[/size][/u][/b]
Build a Cross Station (Cabinet or Terrarium look). Put in one cured bud, then a cured bud of a different strain. 3 days later out come seeds!

- 🌟 Berry Dream = Strawberry Cough + Blue Dream
- 🌟 Tropical Sunset = Pineapple Express + Sunset Sherbet
- 🌟 Cookies & Cream = Girl Scout Cookies + Snowcap Haze
- 🌟 Frosted Lemon = Lemon Haze + Frostbite Kush
- 🌟 Golden Aurora = Northern Lights + Golden Eggnog
- 🌟 Peppermint Punch = Peppermint Frost + Strawberry Cough
- 🌟 Plus Purple Punch, Mango Tango, Cherry Pop, Chamomile Dusk, Caramel Apple and Mint Mocha
- 💌 Make a hybrid for the first time and a discovery note arrives in your mail
- 🎲 Any other pair gives 2 seeds of one of the parents. Rare phenos can appear from Berry Dream, Golden Aurora and Frosted Lemon
- 🍯 Every hybrid has the full chain: buds, joints, edibles, rosin, hash and more
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]💌 LETTERS, ORDERS & BUYER NOTICES[/size][/u][/b]
- 📮 Orders arrive as LETTERS with the villager's portrait, what they want, how many, the exact gold they pay and the due day. Every letter is kept in your collections tab. (You can switch letters off and use the phone only.)
- 🌿 Villagers only ask for what is IN SEASON. Plain bud is requested CURED, others ask for joints, edibles, tea and concentrates
- 📅 Every Monday up to 4 villagers who like you write a regular order
- ✅ Fill an order from your phone (Requests), by talking to the villager, or on the town boards
- 🪧 Buyer notices: the Help Wanted board and the Special Orders board by Pierre's pin your open orders as notes with a Fill button
- 🗳️ Request Boards (craftable, 7 colours): villagers who like you pin requests for edibles, crafts and dishes. Fill them for gold and friendship
- 💰 Pay = sell price + a bonus that grows with your Dealer Rep. Happy customers like you more
────────────────────[b][u]
[size=4]🛍️ SELL TO YOUR NEIGHBORS & DEALER REP[/size][/u][/b]
Hold any StonerVille product and talk to an adult villager: Share it / Sell it / Give as gift. Price grows with your Dealer Rep and with how much they like the item. Villagers who dislike it won't buy. Up to 2 items per villager per day. Kids & teens never.

- 🕴️ Dealer orders from Pam, Shane, Leah, Sebastian, Willy, Gus & Marnie unlock Dealer Rep levels with story letters, better prices (+10% growing to +75%) and new machines: the Cross Station, Hash Press, Packing Table, Chocolate Mint seeds and more
- 👑 Reps go all the way up to Tycoon, with a weekly payout, extra weekly orders and bigger bank loans
- 📝 A sticky note in the lower right shows your Dealer Rep level, how much customers pay, how many orders to the next level and your current order (it hides itself in menus, cutscenes and festivals)
- 🏪 The Dispensary: a counter you stock from jars, shelves and towers, with customers who visit and an OPEN/CLOSED Dispensary Sign
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]⚙️ MACHINES[/size][/u][/b]
- 🪜 Drying Rack & Dark Wood Rack · 150g, 🫙 Curing Jar · 250g
- 🫧 Bong & Pastel Bong · 350g, 🌈 Hippie & Pastel Seed Makers · 150g (accept cured bud)
- 🍯 Rosin Press · 300g, 💎 Dab Rig & Pastel Dab Rig · 350g (Dab Hit buff)
- 🧈 Infusion Pot · 200g (1 dried OR cured bud + any milk = Cannabutter; also Infused Honey and Olive Oil)
- 🪑 Rolling Table · 200g & 📜 Rolling Papers · 20g (Joints, Blunts or Dealer's Special, you choose how many and it only uses the CURED buds you pick)
- 🍪 Edibles Oven · 150g & ✨ Golden Oven · 250g: cook from DRIED or CURED buds
- ⚙️ Grinder · 250g, 🧱 Hash Press · 300g, 🎁 Packing Table · 200g
- 🧬 Cross Station (Cabinet & Terrarium) · 350g
- 🪷 Trippy Hookah · 600g, 2x2
- 🫙 Stash Jar · 200g with strain labels, 📚 Stash Shelf & Lilac Shelf · 250g
- 🚬 Ashtray · 200g (5 Roaches = a Roach Joint)
- 🍹 Beverage Counter · 1200g (8 colours): blender, coffee press and kettle in one piece, making every StonerVille drink
- 🔥 Stoner Stove (800g) and Stoner Oven (900g) at Robin's open the cooking menu for every recipe you know. Topical Table (750g) turns Infused Olive Oil into Hemp Salve, Lotion and Bath Bombs
🍪 Edibles: Brownie, Cookie, Gummies, Swirl Lollipop and Calm Tea, plus Butter versions, each with its own buff. Every strain makes exactly one edible.
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🚬 ROLL, SHARE & SMOKE[/size][/u][/b]
- 🌿 A joint for every strain, each with its own look & buff. 🍂 Blunt (2 cured buds, a big 10 minute buff). 🍫 Dealer's Special (2 cured Chocolate Mint). 🎁 Pre-roll Pack. 🪙 Roaches & Lighters (a Lighter makes buffs last 25% longer)
- 🫶 Hold a joint and interact with an adult villager: some LOVE it, some join in, some politely decline. Joiners get a touch of redness in their eyes in their reply only
- 🪷 The Trippy Hookah: take a rip and up to 3 friendly adults nearby join your circle
- 🪈 4 Hand Pipes at Pierre's (250g): smoke a cured bud of ANY strain and get that strain's joint buff. Adult villagers use pipes around town too
- 🧪 Every strain has a lean and a terpene that add a buff when you smoke
- ☁️ Every smokable plays a fluffy cloud & rainbow sparkle effect
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🎉 THE HIGHER VIBEZ FESTIVAL (Summer 7)[/size][/u][/b]
- 🎪 A tie-dye stage, jumbo animated lava lamps, speakers that pulse, a market, balloon arches, bean bags and mushroom stools
- 🏕️ A walk-in Strain Tasting Tent with 12 jars of real buds and a Chill Zone with an animated fire pit. Use the Tasting Card (K, right stick click) to taste and track strains
- 🏆 Smoking contest: hold the button, release in the sweet zone. 1st place wins 500g, rare seeds and the Golden Spliff Trophy
- 🎡 Prize Wheel, Photo Booth, a big hookah, a free buffet with the Munchies Satisfied buff and a Snack Table shop
- 🎤 Guests Dawgy Kong, Chonk & Cheeba, plus surprise celebs at noon. Share a joint with them for a prize!
- 💌 An invitation letter arrives on Summer 6. Works with heavily modded Town maps
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🏠 THE STONER'S SHED & FURNITURE[/size][/u][/b]
A free farm building from Robin's Carpenter shop, ready in 1 day: a huge blank square room and a giant side room with a stone fireplace, both ready to decorate with their own wallpaper and floors. Fireplaces light themselves, windows show the sky with sunbeams by day and moonlight by night.

- 🛌 Gypsy hippy furniture at Robin's: beds (sleepable from either side), nightstands, dressers, wardrobes, vanities, settees, daybeds, armchairs, tables, bookcases, a potbelly stove, a tea cart and more. 13 wallpapers, 12 floors, 8 retro diner wall signs, 8 hippie rugs, the Crystal Bead Curtain and the Hippy House Clutter set
- 📦 Stash containers with live labels (Joint Canister, Blunt Humidor, Hash Tin, Rosin Jar), 6 Stash Boxes, the Apothecary Tower (24 shelf spots) and display shelves. Boxes, containers and incense burners can sit ON tables
- 🌋 8 Lava Lamps, 6 animated Bubble Tubes and 4 Lava Lamp Tubes, 4 Hanging Plants, 4 Incense Burners with real smoke, the Hippie Leaf Bed, Slouch Beanbag, Tie-Dye Rug, Blacklight Poster, Bead Curtain, Wind Chimes and Party Speaker
- 🌼 12 craftable garden & home decor pieces: Strain Marker, Plant Labels, Compost Bin, Rain Barrel, Stoner Gnome (waters crops overnight), Path Light, Wind Chimes, Raised Bed, Trellis, Bird Bath, Hanging Planter and Potting Bench
- 🕶️ Hippy Glasses, Hemp & Pastel Hoodies and 4 wearable tie-dye tees
- 🍳 Optional StonerVille kitchen for the farmhouse (turn on UseKitchenOverride in the Content Patcher config)
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🍰 FOODS, INFUSIONS & HEMP[/size][/u][/b]
- 🍳 16 kitchen recipes known from the start, each with its own buff: Caramel Apple on a Stick, Hot Cocoa, Peppermint Bark, Chocolate Bar, Sour Gummy Worms, Munchies Pizza, Nachos, Pancake Stack, Rice Crispy Treat, Fudge, Honey Cake, Honey Granola Bar, Pesto Pasta, Garlic Bread, Bruschetta and Veggie Medley
- 🌾 Hemp is a fibre crop with no high: Hemp Seeds (40g at Pierre's) grow in spring, summer or fall. Loom, Oil Maker and Seed Maker make Hemp Cloth, Hemp Seed Oil and seeds. Craft Hemp Rope, Rug, Hammock, Salve, Lotion and Bath Bombs
────────────────────
🌈 THE COMPLETE GREEN-TO-LILAC UI & ANIMATED MAIN MENU
A full tie-dye recolor of the whole interface! Turn it on in Generic Mod Config Menu (or type stonerville_ui on in the SMAPI console) and off any time if you use another UI mod.
- 💚💜 Every menu fades from kush green to lilac, with a rainbow trim and pot leaves on the corners. Tabs, buttons, the clock, the gold box and the toolbar all match. Over 200 menu pictures recolored while you play, nothing from the base game is shipped
- 🍃 The title screen has drifting pot leaves and buds, a green-to-lilac fade and big leaves framing the buttons
- 📖 The Stoner's Bible: a holdable guide book that arrives in the mail from Pierre (or buy a spare for 250g). It covers the whole grow loop, every machine, crosses, orders, the Shed, furniture, the festival and settings, with strain seasons, days and prices read live from your game
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]🛠️ INSTALL[/size][/u][/b]
1. Install SMAPI & Content Patcher.
2. 🗑️ If you are updating, copy the new files over the old ones, or DELETE the old Mods/StonerVille and Mods/StonerVilleGlasses folders first (your saves are not affected).
3. Unzip the download into your Mods folder so you get Mods/StonerVille and Mods/StonerVilleGlasses.
4. Play & shop at Pierre's! 🛒
────────────────────
[b][u][size=4]📝 NOTES[/size][/u][/b]
- ✅ Official release. Only minor fixes and bug fixes from here on. Bug reports welcome in the comments! 💬
- 🧩 The add-on handles the phone, Share a Joint, hand-selling, hookah, festival, beach, orders and crossbreeding. If one feature fails, only that feature turns off.
- 🔍 If something looks wrong, send me your SMAPI log. Typing patch summary in the console also helps.


💚 Made with love by Nesryn Astra Rose 💚
